readings.governedByShape: Coordinator ruling (B), 2026-10-15. POC-REQ-014 reads: 'Every served work item SHALL carry a governing-intent field (`governedBy`) whose value is `Unknown` with the primary reason `source-uncaptured-or-unreachable` and that reason's RFC2-24 resolution route.' It names no basis sentence, so the served value is {label, closedReason, resolutionRoutes (full route form)}; each rendered card's unknownSubjects twin keeps the basis sentence, as every rendered Unknown does.
readings.routeLiteral: Coordinator ruling (a). UNKNOWN_REASON_ROUTES['source-uncaptured-or-unreachable'] now equals RFC2-24's literal, 'Repair the observer/source; new snapshot' (.syzygy/governance/contracts/rfcs/RFC-0002/rendering-vocabularies.md:139), replacing the paraphrase 'Repair the observer or source; new snapshot'. This aligns an implementation paraphrase with accepted contract text and changes no signed behavior. Sweep before the change: grep -F plus a Python second method over 2,751 tracked files (4 undecodable skipped); hits only in code, tests, docs/design/POLARIS-M4-OWNER-LOOP-FUNNEL.md:592 and two retained raws; zero under openspec/ or .syzygy/.
readings.narrowing: The narrowing is a CSS-only checkbox (no script, no new read): checked, it hides every card whose data-governed-by is not Unknown. Every card carries the Unknown, so the narrowed board equals the un-narrowed one; the browser test injects one unmarked card to show the toggle narrows at all.
readings.noNewInput: No work-item column or other input is read: the bd sql statement is unchanged.
readings.reviewFinding1: R-IMPL-P100-GOVERNING-INTENT-1 finding 1 (revise) asked for the count on an Unknown board beside observed work items. buildPocModel never produces that pair: with no seeds the work-item read is itself Unknown ('No seed-backed work-item prefix was supplied'), and projectTrajectory is Unknown only when the read is. governing-intent-sweep.test.ts builds both Unknown-board states (no seeds; unreachable Dolt) and shows neither channel serves an item set, a governedBy or a count.
readings.m03: M03 (omitted governedBy) is killed by a thrown model build (countGoverningIntentUnknown reads the missing field), failing 30 tests; the oracle's own 'no governedBy' limb is shown separately by the falsifier case in governing-intent-sweep.test.ts.

syntheticSize.polarisRouteDelta: On the unreachable model /polaris renders the #10 route 3 times; each copy is 2 bytes shorter, so /polaris shrinks by 6 bytes from the route (a diff of the two pages with the temporary repository path normalized shows only those three lines and the evaluation inputs digest). The default fixture renders it 0 times on /polaris.
